customPages.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
customPages.body:
Last updated: 19 November 2026. This policy covers court bookings and memberships paid online at DK Badminton Academy, Selvapuram North, Coimbatore, and payments made at the academy.

## Court bookings

A court time is yours once it is paid for. While you pay online, the court is held for you for 10 minutes. If the payment doesn't go through in that time, the hold ends and no money is taken.

You can cancel a booking by calling or messaging the academy (see the Contact page) with your booking number.

Cancel 24 hours or more before your start time: full refund.

Cancel between 6 and 24 hours before your start time: 50% refund.

Cancel less than 6 hours before your start time, or don't turn up: no refund.

Instead of cancelling, you can move a booking to another free time once, free of charge, if you ask at least 24 hours before your start time.

## If the academy cancels

If we have to close a court, for example for maintenance, a power cut or an event, we will tell you as soon as we can and you can choose a full refund or another time at no cost.

## Payments that go wrong

If money leaves your account but your booking isn't confirmed (for example, someone else took the court after your hold ended, or you were charged twice), the extra payment is refunded in full automatically. You don't need to ask.

## Memberships

Memberships run month by month from their start date and must be paid before each month begins.

You can stop a membership at any time by telling the academy before your next month starts. Nothing more is charged after that.

A month that has already started is not refunded, including sessions you miss. A month you have paid for that hasn't started yet is refunded in full.

If the academy ends or changes a batch so that you can no longer attend, you can move to another batch or get a refund for the remaining sessions in that month.

## How refunds are paid

Refunds go back to the way you paid. Online payments are refunded through our payment gateway within 2 working days of the refund being approved, and your bank usually shows the money within 5 to 7 working days. Cash and UPI payments made at the academy are refunded at the academy.

Online payment processing charges are not deducted from refunds.

## Contact

For cancellations, refunds or questions about this policy, contact the academy using the details on the Contact page. Please have your booking or membership number ready.

customPages.title: Privacy Policy
customPages.body:
Last updated: 21 November 2026. This explains what personal information DK Badminton Academy (Selvapuram North, Coimbatore) collects through this website and at the academy, why, and what you can ask us to do with it.

## What we collect

When you book a court: your name and mobile number, and your email address if you give one, the court, date and time you chose, and any notes you add.

When you join a membership: your name, mobile number and email address, the players on a court membership, your batch or court time, and your payments.

When you send an enquiry: your name, email address, phone number if you give one, and your message.

When you pay online: payments are handled by our payment gateway, Razorpay. We receive the amount, a payment reference and whether it succeeded. We never see or store your card, UPI or bank details.

## Why we use it

To hold and confirm your booking or membership, take payment, send confirmations and receipts, remind you about renewals, answer your enquiries, issue refunds, and keep the records we need for our accounts.

We contact you about your bookings and membership by email or WhatsApp. We don't send marketing messages, and we don't sell or rent your information to anyone.

## Who else handles it

Razorpay processes online payments. Cloudflare hosts this website and stores its data. Google (Gmail) delivers our emails. WhatsApp carries messages we send you from the academy's phone. Each handles your information only to provide that service. Some of these services may store data outside India.

## How long we keep it

Booking, membership and payment records are kept for as long as accounting and tax law requires. Enquiries are kept while we deal with them and for a reasonable time afterwards. You can ask us to delete information we no longer need to keep.

## Cookies and storage

This website uses no advertising or tracking cookies and no analytics. While you book, your choices are kept in your browser's session storage so they survive a page refresh; this is cleared when you close the tab.

## Your choices and rights

Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you can ask to see the personal information we hold about you, have it corrected, or have it deleted where we don't need to keep it. You can also withdraw consent for messages that aren't needed for a booking or membership you hold.

## Questions and complaints

Contact the academy using the details on the Contact page. We will reply within 7 working days. If you are not satisfied, you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

customPages.title: Terms & Conditions
customPages.body:
Last updated: 21 November 2026. These terms apply when you use this website or book courts, join a membership or play at DK Badminton Academy, Selvapuram North, Coimbatore. By booking or paying you agree to them.

## Booking a court

Bookings are for the court, date and time shown. A court is held for 10 minutes while you pay online and is yours once payment is confirmed. Prices are shown before you pay and include any charges we apply.

Please arrive on time. Your booking ends at the time shown, even if you start late, so the next players can start on time.

Cancellations, moves and refunds follow our Cancellation & Refund Policy.

## Memberships

A membership gives a fixed batch or a fixed court time for one month at a time, and is renewed month by month. It is for the named member (and, for a court membership, the players listed with us) and can't be transferred or shared without our agreement.

Each month must be paid before it starts. If a membership isn't renewed, your batch place or court time may be given to someone else.

Referral codes and credit can only be used as described when they are given, and can't be exchanged for cash.

## At the academy

Wear clean, non-marking sports shoes on court. Look after the courts, nets and equipment; damage caused deliberately or carelessly may be charged for.

Follow staff instructions and treat other players and staff with respect. We may ask anyone who doesn't to leave, without a refund.

Children under 12 must be supervised by an adult unless they are in a coached session.

## Your safety

Badminton is a physical sport. Play within your fitness, warm up, and tell staff about any accident straight away. You play at your own risk, except where an injury is caused by our negligence. We are not responsible for personal belongings left at the academy.

## Changes and closures

We may need to close courts or change times, for example for maintenance, events or reasons outside our control. We will tell you as soon as we can and offer another time or a refund as set out in our Cancellation & Refund Policy.

We may update prices and these terms. Changes don't affect bookings and membership months already paid for.

## Using this website

Give accurate details when you book so we can reach you. Don't misuse the website or try to book courts you don't intend to use.

## Law

These terms are governed by the laws of India, and the courts of Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu have jurisdiction.

## Contact

For questions about these terms, contact the academy using the details on the Contact page.
